articles.summary: Building and maintaining an effective training program shouldn’t require spreadsheets, manual reminders, or duct-taped systems. In this webinar, we walked through how modern fintechs, banks, and regulated organizations use Affinity to design, automate, and manage training programs: from onboarding to annual requirements and everything in between.
